audit_scope: PCRR, CSRC, ASR, and PGM mathematics
risk, matching, triage, and shifted-control measurements
bootstrap, sign-flip, Holm, gates, ranking, and winner logic

hard_boundaries.new_gt_rule: No new GT evaluation; no MVTec mask pixels or image pixels may be read.
hard_boundaries.model_forward_rule: Do not instantiate or run the model.

allowed_inputs: committed frozen manifests, hashes, metadata, and scalar/config artifacts
historical post-GT outputs for forensic comparison only
synthetic arrays and pure mathematical checks

recoverability_classes.S3: Deterministic scientific aggregation, selection, or statistical defect recoverable from frozen scalar artifacts without new GT.
recoverability_classes.S4: Evidence-construction defect requiring new evidence or new GT.

allowed: Only a rule unambiguously frozen before GT may be corrected.
All correction inputs must already exist in immutable committed scalar artifacts.
The correction must be deterministic, result-direction-independent, and require no image, mask, GT, or model access.
If a pre-GT semantic rule is ambiguous, classify PROTOCOL_AMBIGUOUS and do not promote a preferred interpretation.
forbidden: Changing PCRR, CSRC, ASR, or PGM mathematics
Changing B1, K, folds, thresholds, risk/triage budgets, gates, or winner rules
Changing percentile evidence construction when it changes evidence
Adding/removing configurations or tuning after observing results
Reconstructing pixel maps or rereading masks

certification_logic.case_b_condition: Only S1-S3 defects exist and every correction is deterministically reconstructable from frozen scalar artifacts without new GT.
certification_logic.case_c_condition: Any S4/S5 defect exists, or protocol ambiguity prevents a unique scientific correction.

analysis_order: only if authorized, compute deterministic scalar-only reconciliation
